singlePurpose: Submit GitHub pull request approvals from a compact button in the PR header.

permissionJustifications.storage: Stores the user-supplied GitHub token, validated account identity, and approval attempt records locally in this Chrome profile. Attempt records prevent duplicate approvals when a request's result is uncertain. Also stores bounded local diagnostic history and the private key for pseudonymous context IDs; reports are exported only at the user's request.
permissionJustifications.https://github.com/*: Reads the signed-in GitHub username and current pull request identity and inserts the approval control in the new PR header. GitHub's client-side navigation requires the script to load before navigation to a PR. It does not scan unrelated websites or collect general browsing history.
permissionJustifications.https://api.github.com/*: Validates the user's token, reads the current PR and the user's own reviews, and submits an approval after the user clicks Quick approve. All requests use HTTPS and go directly to GitHub.

remoteCodeJustification: All executable code is bundled in the extension. It does not load or execute remote scripts or WebAssembly.

Personally identifiable information.details: The signed-in GitHub username read from the current page, the token owner's ID and username, and PR and review author IDs selected in GitHub GraphQL API responses.

Authentication information.details: The user's personal access token is stored locally and sent only to GitHub's API.

Personal communications.details: GitHub GraphQL requests select review metadata without requesting or receiving pull request descriptions or review comment bodies.

Location.details: GitHub GraphQL requests do not request or receive profile location. The extension does not request device geolocation.

Web history.details: The current GitHub PR URL identifies the review target. Local approval attempt records identify the associated repository and PR. General browsing history is not collected.

User activity.details: Local approval attempt records track a requested approval to prevent duplicate submission. The extension does not record general clicks, keystrokes, or browsing activity. Local diagnostic history records operation timestamps, safe state transitions, errors, and timings to investigate bugs. It can be disabled, cleared, or exported in settings; it is not uploaded automatically.

Website content.details: The current GitHub PR identity is read from the page. GraphQL requests select PR IDs, state, merged status, head commit ID, author ID, and the user's own review IDs, state, and author ID, including private repositories the user authorizes. Approval responses contain only the submitted review's ID and state.
